top_news.summary: Anthropic PBC warned it may need to seek more financing sooner than the artificial-intelligence company had anticipated while saying little about its potential path to an investment-grade credit rating in its closely watched IPO filing.

top_news.title: Duke’s Mayo CEO: Our Room for Growth Is Substantial
top_news.summary: E. Yuri Hermida, CEO of Duke’s Mayo Company, discussed the company’s name change from Sauer Brands as it enters a new growth chapter. After divesting its spice business, the company is centering its identity on Duke’s Mayo, whose heritage and recipe date to 1917, while also owning Mateo’s Gourmet Salsa. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: AI Funding Drives US High-Grade Bond Sales to Annual Record
top_news.summary: US investment-grade bond sales set an annual record on Monday, as a surge in artificial intelligence spending drives companies to borrow hundreds of billions of dollars.

top_news.title: Pimco Scoops Up $4 Billion of Massive SpaceX AI Debt Package
top_news.summary: Pacific Investment Management Co. bought a $4 billion slice of a huge SpaceX financing deal that will help expand its artificial intelligence ambitions, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: Jennifer Garner on Expanding Reach of Once Upon a Farm
top_news.summary: Actress Jennifer Garner is also the chief brand officer and co-founder of Once Upon a Farm that makes organic food for babies and children. She talks about her involvement in the business, keeping prices affordable and the introduction of food enhanced with electrolytes. She speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: Colombia Sells $5.2 Billion in New Bonds Amid Fiscal Strain
top_news.summary: Colombia sold a record $5.2 billion in dollar-denominated bonds on Monday as a new administration pledges to rein in the widening budget gap and put the nation’s debt back on a sustainable path.

top_news.title: Nucor Profit Beats Estimates as Higher Steel Prices Lift Results
top_news.summary: Nucor Corp. reported third-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street expectations as higher steel prices helped boost profits at the largest US steelmaker.

top_news.title: Blackstone Data-Center Operator QTS Seeks $800 Million in Private Placement Debt
top_news.summary: QTS, a data-center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., is looking to raise around $800 million through a private placement of debt, as Wall Street looks to every corner of global credit to finance artificial intelligence infrastructure.
